output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balanceOf target address is increased without a check, allowing the totalSupply to be arbitrarily increased, resulting in a decrease in the balance of the owner.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_from] is decreased, if it is less than _value, it will overflow and set balanceOf[_from] to zero, preventing further transfers from this address.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decreased, if it is less than _value, it will overflow and set allowance[_from][msg.sender] to zero, allowing attackers to transfer arbitrary amounts of tokens from any user accounts.

The transferFrom function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It decreases the allowance by _value, but does not check if the balanceOf[_from] is enough to decrease, allowing attackers to transfer arbitrary amounts of tokens from any user accounts.
